newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Australia drop Slater for first test.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Australia drop Slater for first test.

text.p: New South Wales opener Michael Slater has been dropped for the first test against West Indies, starting in Brisbane on Friday.
Slater has been replaced by Victoria counterpart Matthew Elliot, who is expected to partner Australia captain and opener Mark Taylor, in a 12-man squad.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Ricky Ponting, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Paul Reiffel, Glenn McGrath, Michael Kasprowicz, Jason Gillespie.
